sub_graphs.title: EIP-7702: Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for type-4 transactions and delegated calls

nodes.label: Gas Calculation Starting
nodes.description: Beginning intrinsic gas calculation for type-4 transaction

nodes.label: Calculate Base Intrinsic Gas
nodes.description: Compute standard intrinsic: 21000 + calldata costs

nodes.label: Calculate Access List Cost
nodes.description: Add 2400 per address + 1900 per storage key in access list

nodes.label: Calculate Authorization List Cost
nodes.description: Add PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST (25000) per authorization tuple

nodes.label: Intrinsic Gas Computed
nodes.description: Total intrinsic gas for type-4 transaction calculated

nodes.label: Calculate Delegation Access Cost
nodes.description: Add COLD_ACCOUNT_READ_COST (2600) or WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST (100) per delegation resolution

nodes.label: Execution Gas Computed
nodes.description: Total gas including delegation resolution costs calculated

nodes.label: PER_AUTH_BASE_COST: 12500
nodes.description: Base gas cost per authorization for processing

nodes.label: PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST: 25000
nodes.description: Gas cost for delegating to an empty account

nodes.label: COLD_ACCOUNT_READ_COST: 2600
nodes.description: Gas cost for first access to delegation target

nodes.label: WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST: 100
nodes.description: Gas cost for subsequent access to delegation target

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'permanently set the code' but also allows clearing delegation with address 0x0, making 'permanent' misleading.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Interpret 'permanent' as meaning the delegation persists across transactions (unlike transient storage), not that it cannot be changed.

ambiguities.text: Transaction pool recommendation to 'not accept more than one pending transaction' for delegated EOAs is not formally specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a soft recommendation and implementations may vary in enforcement strictness.

ambiguities.text: No specification for how delegation indicator interacts with CREATE/CREATE2 opcodes if executed in delegated context.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume CREATE/CREATE2 use the EOA's nonce and address derivation follows standard rules with EOA as sender.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'delegation loops only follow first level' does not clearly define behavior for chains A->B->C where B also has delegation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume delegation is resolved only once: if A delegates to B and B delegates to C, calls to A execute B's code (not C's).

implicit_assumptions.description: Users signing authorization tuples understand they are granting code execution rights to their account.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could unknowingly grant malicious contracts control over their EOA, leading to fund theft.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers can observe pending transactions and attempt front-running or sandwich attacks on delegation setup.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: N/A - this is acknowledged; mitigation requires users to sign setup calldata with ecrecover.

implicit_assumptions.description: Existing contracts relying on msg.sender == tx.origin for EOA detection will have that invariant broken.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: N/A - this is explicitly acknowledged as a breaking change with security implications.

implicit_assumptions.description: Delegation target contracts will properly implement nonce/replay protection within their own logic.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing replay protection in delegates allows attackers to reuse authorization signatures for unintended actions.

implicit_assumptions.description: The 0xef0100 prefix is reserved and will not conflict with future EVM features or EOF.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Conflicts with future EVM extensions could cause undefined behavior for delegated accounts.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet and dApp developers will update UIs to properly display and warn about authorization signing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may sign malicious authorizations without understanding the consequences.
